description: Use this when you need to find a public fishing water by name for research or a citation. Optional two-letter state. Only states open for indexing are searched, at most 25 hits, each with its castthewater.com page URL. An empty query returns no results. Call fetch with an id from these results.

query.description: Water name or words to search. An empty query returns no results.

state.description: Optional US state abbreviation. Closed states are left out.

name: search
